[USER] User is interested in eradicating walnut webworms without harming beneficial insects.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There are several methods to control walnut webworms without harming beneficial insects:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Natural predators: Encourage the presence of natural predators like birds, spiders, and wasps in the garden.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Biological control: Introducing natural enemies of walnut webworms into the garden, such as Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) spray can be applied on the plants to kill the larvae.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Physical removal: Handpicking the larvae and cocoons by hand can be effective.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Cultural practices: Pruning affected branches and cleaning fallen leaves in the fall can help reduce walnut webworm populations.
